title: Shiv — Desi
description: Indian creators in Hindi and English — interviews, comedy, culture. Curated private feed for Apple Podcasts.
author: Shivanshu Chaudhary

items.title: EP-449 | "India Looks So Poor": Manu Joseph on Broken Cities, Gen Z, Jobs, CM Vijay & PM Modi
items.description: Novelist-journalist Manu Joseph on why India 'looks' poor — aesthetic diagnosis as political craft, not cheerleading.

items.title: EP-451 | Mahatma Gandhi, India’s History, Leftist Historians, Savarkar & Tipu Sultan | Vikram Sampath
items.description:
Idea: Sampath treats historiography as a contested operating system — who gets canonized (Gandhi/Savarkar/Tipu) is a power allocation, not a trivia quiz.
Sharpens taste: listen for how evidence, grievance, and nation-branding argue past each other in long-form Indian public history.

items.title: Ep 453: Srikrishna Ayyangar Examines Populism
items.show: The Seen and the Unseen - hosted by Amit Varma
items.description:
India’s populisms as operating systems: Ayyangar maps state-level logics — who gets named ‘the people,’ which institutions bend, and how performance becomes policy.
Desi densifier: treat populism as craft of coalition, not just speech.

items.title: EP-450 | Raj Kapoor, Dawood Ibrahim & Bollywood’s Secrets: Mandakini Reveals All
items.description: Desi culture lane, not Rajput lore: Mandakini on Raj Kapoor’s set craft, Bollywood power, and the underworld adjacency — oral history as industry OS.

items.title: LEGENDARY RAJPUT HISTORY - Veerta, Jauhar Aur Balidaan Ki Kahani | Rajveer Sir On TRS
items.description:
Rajveer Sir joins The Ranveer Show हिंदी for legendary Rajput history — veerta, jauhar, and balidaan. Oral history of valor and sacrifice that shaped North Indian martial identity.

Hindi long-form keeps martial memory alive outside textbooks — Rajput veerta/jauhar as identity performance, not museum fact.
Craft: BeerBiceps oral-history mode turns legend into listen-through culture for the diaspora ear.

Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/legendary-rajput-history-veerta-jauhar-aur-balidaan/id1542452346?i=1000790674235

items.title: Ep 452: Harini Nagendra is Woolgathering and Ground Truthing
items.show: The Seen and the Unseen - hosted by Amit Varma
items.description:
The city and nature do not need to be at odds with each other; and dreamers can be doers. Harini Nagendra joins Amit Varma in episode 452 of The Seen and the Unseen to discuss her work in ecology, urban sustainability, detective fiction and the art of managing multitudes.

Why this sharpens your taste: Nagendra’s move is “ground truthing” — refuse abstract green talk until you’ve counted actual canopy, birds, and street-level tradeoffs. Craft move: pair woolgathering (imagination) with measurement so Indian urban ecology isn’t vibes.

Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/ep-452-harini-nagendra-is-woolgathering-and-ground/id1190896090?i=1000788228084

items.title: Will ChatGPT Book Your Next Holiday? | MakeMyTrip x Taj Hotels | WTF is Travel?
items.description:
Access the full data and references used in this episode below. Please open this alongside the episode while watching. Open Reference Document I put Rajesh Magow, the chartered accountant who co-founded MakeMyTrip on a team where almost nobody knew travel, and Puneet Chhatwal, the Delhi boy who spent twenty-eight years running hotels in Europe before coming home to pull IHCL out of a decade of losses, into one room to explain the business of Indian travel from scratch, and what came out was far bigger than a lesson, from why boutique hotels are better built by outsiders and how a fifty crore partnership between their companies became twelve hundred, to what a hotel actually pays to sit on MakeMyTrip and why booking direct still isn't cheaper, why ChatGPT can't scrape its way into the travel funnel and where voice bookings are tak

Why this sharpens your taste: Nikhil Kamath’s MakeMyTrip × Taj long-form sits in the Indian founder register — travel stack, AI booking, hospitality ops without US-VC cosplay.
Craft move: listen for how Indian consumer platforms narrate distribution and trust, not just product demos.

Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/will-chatgpt-book-your-next-holiday-makemytrip-x-taj/id1821810331?i=1000789001845
